_doc: The main line (UI spec §3.4; build item N-1.5): one gold step under the vitals naming the next main-story action, in the camp's voice. at (N-8.4): map:place where it happens, glowing on the map and pointed at by the HUD's compass needle. The first step whose when (a story condition) holds is shown; none shows nothing. Hidden in fights. Written by the story threads as the story grows; these cover the first playable.

steps.when: loop == 1 and not f("drill_done") and day <= 2
steps.text: Warm up: run the drill at the Watch's straw targets in the square (G).
Crane's lesson is at Morning on Ashmoon 3, by the College tents. Till then, meet the camp (G), and sleep on your cot to end the day.
Be on the practice ground by the College tents at Morning on Ashmoon 3: Crane wants every apprentice.
Lector Marrow teaches on the practice ground at Morning on Ashmoon 5. Till then, the commissions board in the square has paid work.
Fennick wants you at the Guild bench, at the back of the market.

steps.when: on_road("lamplighter") and day == 70 and not seen("reckoning")
steps.text: The Market reckoning is this morning, in the Lantern Market.
The Market reckoning is on the morning of Seedmoon 14. Fennick wants you in the black by nightfall.

steps.when: day >= 8 and day <= 28 and not f("cellar_asked")
steps.text: Aldous at the Mill has been asking for you.

steps.when: f("cellar_asked") and not f("cellar_done") and day <= 28
steps.text: Aldous needs his seed barley. Go down into the Mill cellar, under the mill.

steps.when: day >= 6 and day <= 7 and not on_road("lamplighter")
steps.text: Free days. Try the commissions board in the square, the duel ring by the College, or the north stair down into the ruins.

steps.when: day <= 49 and not seen("thaw_exam") and not on_road("lamplighter")
steps.text: The Thaw examination is at Morning on Thaw 21, on the practice ground by the College tents.

steps.when: day >= 57 and day < 67 and not f("daybook_asked")
steps.text: Wren has been looking for you.

steps.when: f("daybook_yes") and day <= 67 and not f("daybook")
steps.text: Meet Wren at the Archive stair, past the Kiln, on Seedmoon 11.
Go down the north stair and find a way through the College halls to the Kiln.
Go on past the Kiln hall, deeper into the College.
